reasoning_content: Memory is extremely tight (191MB free). Let me check whether the board can complete its build under these conditions. The board build took 65 seconds when run standalone with enough memory. With app + cms + board all running, it might be slow. Let me wait and check. I could consider reducing load, but the containers need to keep running. Let's see how it goes.

action.command:
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  if curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:37315/ 2>/dev/null; then echo "boards responding at attempt $i"; break; fi
  sleep 55
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "boards direct: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:37315/ 2>/dev/null || echo "boards not yet"
echo "=== boards log ==="; tail -5 /tmp/serve-boards.log
free -m | sed -n '2p'

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "for i in $(seq 1 10); do

  sleep 55
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "boards direct: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:37315/ 2>/dev/null || echo "boards not yet"
echo "=== boards log ==="; tail -5 /tmp/serve-boards.log
free -m | sed -n '2p'", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Wait for boards dev server"}
